text:
jordan-partners: Hey team — quick ask for vendor input we need for the cost model: can partners give us the effective spot premium, min commit window (months), and whether onboarding credits / marketplace listing fees are refundable? Trying to consolidate into the Q3 supply sheet.
jordan-partners: cc @vendor-bot — can you drop the latest table from VegaCompute and any notes about commit cliffs or tranche release patterns? :pray:
vendor-bot: VegaCompute: CSV export attached (link) — key fields: sku, reserved_months, spot_premium_pct, onboarding_credit_usd, refundable_flag. Note: spot_premium_pct is a 30-day median.
maria-finance: thx. Quick question — onboarding_credit_usd is per-sku or per-account? That changes unit economics a lot.
vendor-bot: @maria-finance per-account for Enterprise SKUs, per-sku for marketplace ephemeral SKUs. See sample row:
```
sku=vc-p4d8x,reserved_months=12,spot_premium_pct=23,onboarding_credit_usd=5000,refundable_flag=false
```
raj: helpful. For the cost model I'd also need typical fulfillment lag (days) after commit and a probability of eviction for spot (%). Do vendors provide eviction distribution by hour?
vendor-bot: eviction_prob_hourly is coarse: typical ranges 0.2%–1.5% depending on region and SKU. Fulfillment lag: 3–14 days based on inventory. We'll add a column to the export.
kelly-eng: practical note — if reserved_months < 6 we see higher variance in actual realized throughput because our scheduler prioritizes long-commits. Can vendors provide tranche release cadence? (e.g., 30% at month 0, 70% after 3 months).
vendor-bot: adding tranche_release JSON in next export. Example: ["0:30%","90:70%"].
tim-ops: Also flag any geo restrictions. If a SKU is region-locked we should treat routing cost differently. Add region_code column please.
vendor-bot: Will do. One more: marketplace listing fees — some partners defer fees to a closing settlement (net 60). That affects short-window pricing; marking payment_terms in export.
jordan-partners: Amazing — can you also include a binary field for "allow_burst" (true/false) and a suggested burst_markup_pct? That feeds into our burst pricing assumptions.
vendor-bot: added allow_burst, burst_markup_pct. Sample: allow_burst=true,burst_markup_pct=18
maria-finance: From finance POV, we should also get the historical effective blended cost after discounts (3-yr view) for reserved SKUs. Otherwise our model will overestimate unit cost. Can you ask for a 12-quarter blended_cost_usd?
raj: and please flag any minimum monthly spend (commit floors). Those change whether we classify as reserved vs dedicated in modelling.
jordan-partners: I'll assemble a follow-up ask to partners with the exact CSV schema and sample values. Thanks — aim to close this by EOD so modeling can run overnight. :rocket:
kelly-eng: FYI once we have tranche_release and eviction distribution I'll run a small sim to show tail-latency/cost tradeoffs and post results here.
jordan-partners: perfect. If anyone wants to add a quick sensitivity we should include spot_premium +/-5/10 ppt and tranche delays +/- 2 weeks.
maria-finance: noted. If vendors push refundable_flag=true we get optional offsets in the P&L modeling; please surface legal terms for refunds.
raj: thanks all — follow-up export expected from @vendor-bot in ~2 hours.
vendor-bot: Export queued, will post link when ready. :white_check_mark:
